mapreducescript.description: Topaz Harbor Data Patcher for query-driven admin batch updates.
mapreducescript.name: TH Data Patcher

scriptcustomfield.label: SuiteQL
scriptcustomfield.description: SuiteQL query used by this deployment. Return recordtype plus aliases for body/sublist/action processing.
scriptcustomfield.help: Required. Return recordtype and, for update/delete rows, recordid. Use fieldid_<fieldid> for body fields, linefield_<fieldid> plus sublistid and lineuniquekey for sublist updates, optional action values of update/create/delete, optional operationsequence for deferred ordering, and a deterministic ORDER BY.

scriptcustomfield.label: Force Load + Save Mode
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, use record.load/record.save instead of submitFields.
scriptcustomfield.help: Check when body-field updates must run through full record load/save instead of submitFields, such as fields with sourcing, validation, or inline-edit limits. Sublist updates already use load/save.

scriptcustomfield.label: Dry Run
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, no records are updated. Logs preview output only.
scriptcustomfield.help: Recommended for first runs. Logs the action, record, and values that would be applied without creating, updating, or deleting anything.

scriptcustomfield.label: Stop On Error
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, script exits immediately on first patch failure.
scriptcustomfield.help: Check to stop after the first failed update, create, or delete. Earlier changes are not rolled back; remaining rows are skipped once the abort flag is set.

scriptcustomfield.label: Max Rows
scriptcustomfield.description: Optional row cap. 0 means no explicit cap.
scriptcustomfield.help: Optional safety cap on the input query. Set 0 for no cap, or use a small number for staged rollout, troubleshooting, or sample runs.

scriptcustomfield.label: Alias Prefix
scriptcustomfield.description: Column alias prefix used to identify update fields.
scriptcustomfield.help: Prefix used to identify body-field aliases in SuiteQL. With the default fieldid_, a column aliased as fieldid_memo updates the memo field.

scriptcustomfield.label: Query Custom Script ID
scriptcustomfield.description: Optional query customScriptId used for query diagnostics.
scriptcustomfield.help: Optional customScriptId passed into SuiteQL execution for query traceability and diagnostics. Change only if you need a different identifier in NetSuite query tooling.

scriptcustomfield.label: Enable Create/Delete Actions
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, action=create and action=delete rows are allowed.
scriptcustomfield.help: Check to allow rows with action values of create or delete. Leave unchecked to restrict this deployment to update actions only.
